approval_reference: 사용자 최신 지시: 좋아 진행해. 기존 권장안인 CIRCLE_CLOCK_POST_TASK8_HUMAN_DEVICE_ACCESSIBILITY_PRECHECK을 현행 Story Front Door/Circle/Clock runtime에 맞춰 계속 진행한다.

entries.source_and_evidence: W3C WCAG 2.2 Understanding Target Size (Minimum), checked 2026-09-01: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html
entries.observed_pattern: Pointer target의 최소 크기 또는 간격은 오입력과 물리적 정밀도 부담을 줄이는 원칙이며, Web CSS pixel 기준이다.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADAPT physical device observation으로 target_size_and_spacing, 오입력, display/text scale을 기록한다. Web WCAG 준수나 특정 dp 값 PASS를 주장하지 않는다.

entries.observed_pattern: Control은 focus_mode와 accessibility name/description을 제공하고, anchors/Containers는 multiple-resolution layout의 구현 수단이다.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: ADOPT current Control node와 existing automated contract를 device/input observation의 출발점으로 사용한다. API 존재, editor screenshot, headless layout matrix를 screen reader/device PASS로 바꾸지 않는다.

No Godot source/scene/asset/card-rule/runtime behavior change, no legacy-save write, no Base change, and no unrelated PR action.

actual_runtime_evidence: Story Front Door live UI tree and 1280x720 screenshot analysis were nonblank with no observed clipping; New Record route was invoked.
AdmissionPrologue live UI exposed 입학의 아침 and ContinueNarrativeButton; route advanced to StoryEventRoot.
StoryEventRoot live UI exposed direct glyph writing, Preview, target, commit, and the 0/6 goal plus 0/4 threat clocks; editor diagnostics were 0 errors and 0 warnings.

Godot 4.7.1 headless custom runner was re-executed through a Windows Start-Process argument vector and exited 0. The user://logs/godot.log timestamp refreshed and its final JSON reported 31 suites, 1,370 assertions, 0 failures. A direct PowerShell native invocation produced only startup text without a fresh script log, so it is not counted as runtime evidence.
Custom game QA discovery reported no project-defined QA methods, so the protocol uses current live nodes and requires human evidence rather than inventing a QA API.
implementation_feasibility_recheck.limit: This verifies that the observation surface exists in the actual editor/worktree, not that an actual person, physical device, assistive technology, performance run, export, or full vertical slice was validated.

adversarial_review_loops.full_scope_attack: A generic human script could validate the historical Star or W6 target-priority flow rather than the active story-led Circle/Clock runtime.
adversarial_review_loops.finding: Current consumer flow is Story Front Door -> AdmissionPrologue -> StoryEventRoot, and its first interaction is direct glyph writing followed by explicit Preview/target/cast.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Bind every observation step and evidence record to the actual scenes/nodes; reject the retired Star pack as current owner.

adversarial_review_loops.full_scope_attack: Editor screenshots, static accessibility_name assertions, and headless layout tests could be misreported as player/device/accessibility evidence.
adversarial_review_loops.finding: Each confirms only a technical surface, not comprehension, touch precision, screen-reader behavior, or a physical device.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Set PREPARED_NOT_RUN ceiling, require an actual person or physical device session, and keep every evidence axis separate.

adversarial_review_loops.full_scope_attack: Copying Web WCAG dimensions into the game could falsely claim conformance or force a layout without observing its runtime effect.
adversarial_review_loops.finding: W3C target guidance is useful but CSS-pixel-specific; Godot APIs are implementation mechanisms, not a device verdict.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: ADAPT target size/spacing to repeatable physical-device observation and record display/text scale, focus, and assistive-service state.

adversarial_review_loops.full_scope_attack: The protocol might manufacture card rules, clock balance, a hidden best target, or new story content while trying to make the session testable.
adversarial_review_loops.finding: Card detailed rules remain RULESET_PENDING and the first event must preserve explicit player choice rather than an answer key.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Exclude card rule values/content changes and ask non-leading questions about goals, threats, Preview, target, and cast.

adversarial_review_loops.full_scope_attack: Observation preparation could mutate production assets, runtime behavior, legacy save data, or collect personal data without adding valid validation evidence.
adversarial_review_loops.finding: No new asset consumer is required, legacy Star save has no current migration consumer, and raw participant wording can be retained without identifiers.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Forbid runtime edits during observation, preserve legacy save untouched, require consent/path-only capture records, and keep findings as a later work unit.
